subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source-disable setting for built-in `.agents/skills` roots, and what shape should that setting take?
rationale: The requested fix adds public configuration surface and changes an intentionally documented built-in skill source, so repository policy requires maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Typed source-disable list
options.body: Add a default-off `skills.load.disableSources` list for known source ids such as `agents-skills-personal`, and skip disabled sources in discovery, watching, status, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow personal-source toggle
options.body: Add a smaller boolean for only `~/.agents/skills`, reducing config scope but likely creating another option if project-agent sources need the same treatment later.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Decline the new config surface and direct users to agent allowlists, prompt limits, or moving Claude Code skills out of the shared directory.

recommendation.title: Typed source-disable list
recommendation.body: Add a default-off `skills.load.disableSources` list for known source ids such as `agents-skills-personal`, and skip disabled sources in discovery, watching, status, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent history across the current skills loader and watcher surfaces where the decision would be implemented.
